notes.text:
# Orion travel policy

Reference ORION-TRAVEL-47. Staff should take the train for trips under four hours. Air travel needs manager approval.

# Orion expense claims

Submit receipts within thirty days. Meals have a daily reimbursement cap.

# Luna backup schedule

Create encrypted database snapshots each night and retain them for thirty days.

# Luna restoration

Reference LUNA-RESTORE-91. Verify the backup checksum, restore to an isolated instance and compare row counts.

# Cedar bedroom sleep

Keep the bedroom cool and dark. If indoor temperature stays high overnight, use air conditioning.

# Cedar ventilation

Open windows when outdoor air is cooler than indoor air. Use a fan to move fresh air through the room.

# Maple OAuth permissions

Reference MAPLE-AUTH-63. Google sign-in establishes identity. The backend grants each AI client explicit scopes and path access.

# Maple knowledge search

Hybrid retrieval combines keyword ranking with semantic vector similarity and cites the original note.

# Atlas coffee

Grind beans immediately before brewing espresso. Adjust grind size to control extraction time.

# Atlas tea

Reference ATLAS-TEA-28. Steep green tea with cooler water for a short time to avoid bitterness.

# 青竹旅行

短途出行优先乘坐火车。长途航班需要提前审批，并保存行程凭证。

# 青竹备份

每天夜间创建加密备份，并定期验证恢复流程和文件校验和。
